name: OmniTrust for WooCommerce
author: prestawach

sections.description:
OmniTrust protects your WooCommerce store from two costly problems: cash-on-delivery (COD)
non-collection and wardrobing/return abuse. It never blocks or bans a customer at checkout.
Instead, it uses a “Flag & Hold” approach that runs quietly in the background, after checkout.

How it works

  • After a shopper completes checkout, the plugin sends the order to the OmniTrust API for a
    fraud-risk evaluation, in the background (via WooCommerce’s Action Scheduler). This never
    delays or blocks checkout.
  • If OmniTrust returns a high risk verdict, the order is set to On hold, a private
    (admin-only) order note explains why, and the order is tagged for review.
  • If the verdict is low risk, the order’s status is left unchanged; a private note simply
    confirms the evaluation completed.
  • If the evaluation call itself fails, a private note says so — no automatic retry happens, but
    you can manually trigger a “Start evaluation” action from the order screen at any time.
  • Once an order has been evaluated, you can also manually report COD non-collection or
    wardrobing/return abuse for it from the order screen. This helps build the wider OmniTrust
    merchant network that other stores’ evaluations rely on too.

No email or other message is ever sent to the buyer as a result of any of this.

Important limitation: Flag & Hold is not a pre-purchase block

Flag & Hold runs after checkout completes, asynchronously, so it never slows down or blocks
your buyers — but that also means it is a weaker guarantee than a pre-purchase block. If your
store’s fulfillment is very fast (e.g. same-minute pick/pack/ship), it is possible for an order
to ship before the hold has a chance to apply.

Pricing

OmniTrust offers a genuine Free tier — $0/mo, up to 100 risk checks per month, with the
same reporting features as every paid tier. Two paid tiers unlock a higher monthly evaluation
limit for busier stores: Standard (€10/mo, up to 1,000 risk checks/month) and Business
(€50/mo, unlimited risk checks). All three tiers share identical Flag & Hold and reporting
behavior — the only difference between tiers is how many /evaluate risk checks are included
per month.

After installing, go to Settings → OmniTrust to choose a tier (this takes you to a secure
LemonSqueezy checkout) or, if you already have a license key, activate it directly on the same
page. Without an active license key, the plugin stays installed but inactive — its hooks simply
do not register, so it never partially breaks your store or nags you to upgrade.

External services

This plugin connects to the OmniTrust API (OmniTrust’s own first-party backend — not a
third-party service) for fraud-risk evaluation and for the manual reporting features described
above. This happens:

  • automatically, in the background, shortly after a customer completes checkout, sending
    order and store data for fraud-risk evaluation, and
  • only when you manually trigger “Report COD non-collection” or “Report wardrobing/deshopping”
    on a specific order, sending that order’s data for the report.

If OmniTrust’s API is ever unreachable, the plugin fails safe: your orders are left in their
normal, unmodified state, and no error is ever shown to the buyer.

This service is provided by OmniTrust: Privacy Policy,
which covers full details on what is collected, how it’s hashed (identifiers are HMAC-hashed
on arrival and never stored raw), and how cross-merchant matching works.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress admin (Plugins → Add New, search for “OmniTrust for
    WooCommerce”) or upload the ZIP manually (Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin), then click
    Activate.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce 6.0 or later is installed and active — this plugin does nothing without
    it.
  3. Go to Settings → OmniTrust. If you don’t have a license key yet, choose a tier there
    (Free, Standard, or Business — see “Pricing” above) to check out via LemonSqueezy. Already
    have a license key? Paste it into the License key activation field and click Activate.
    This exchanges your license key for an API key automatically — you never need to request or
    paste in a raw API key yourself.
  4. Once activation succeeds, the plugin’s Flag & Hold evaluation and reporting features are
    live. No further configuration is required.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin block or ban customers?

No. OmniTrust never blocks a purchase or bans a customer. Flag & Hold only ever puts a
high-risk order on hold for your own review, after checkout has already completed.

Do I need a paid subscription?

No — OmniTrust has a genuine Free tier (up to 100 risk checks per month, same reporting
features as the paid tiers). Standard and Business tiers exist only to raise that monthly
limit for busier stores. See “Pricing” in the Description above.

What happens if OmniTrust’s API is unreachable?

The plugin fails safe: your orders are left in their normal, unmodified state, and no error is
ever shown to the buyer.

Does this slow down my checkout?

No. Evaluation always runs in the background, after checkout completes, via WooCommerce’s
Action Scheduler.

What data does this plugin send to OmniTrust?

See “External services” above.

short_description: Async fraud-signal evaluation (Flag & Hold) and merchant-initiated fraud reporting for WooCommerce, backed by the OmniTrust API.
